$comment: UmActually PR review task — IN DEVELOPMENT. The 'name' MUST match the folder name (ReviewTask) and the contribution 'properties.name' in vss-extension.json. The 'id' is a unique GUID; generate a fresh one before publishing. See ado-extension/README.md for the GUID generation step.
name: ReviewTask
description: Run the UmActually PR review CLI against the current pipeline's PR context and post inline review threads. Provider-agnostic (OpenAI-compatible, Anthropic, GitHub Copilot).
helpMarkDown:
[UmActually PR Review](https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/umactually) — see the [Azure DevOps quickstart](https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/umactually#azure-devops-quickstart) for full pipeline setup.

**Required pipeline variables** (set on the variable group or pipeline):
- `UMACTUALLY_API_URL` — provider base URL
- `UMACTUALLY_API_KEY` — provider API key (mark **secret**)

**Required service connection**: the build service identity must have `Contribute to pull requests` permission on the target repo.

**Behavior**: by default the task posts review threads (live). Set `--no-dry-run` to `false` to log the review without posting. The task exits 0 on a clean run, 1 on a failed review, 2 on misuse.
author: UmActually

inputs.name: apiUrl
inputs.label: Provider API URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of the review provider. **Prefer setting `UMACTUALLY_API_URL` as a pipeline variable** so the same task can be reused across repos. Leave blank to inherit from the env var. See the [provider protocol reference](https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/umactually/blob/main/docs/providers.md) for the per-family URL resolution rules — on dual-protocol gateways (e.g. `https://api.minimax.io/anthropic`) the dispatcher auto-discovers the protocol at the URL regardless of `--provider`.

inputs.name: apiKey
inputs.label: Provider API key
inputs.helpMarkDown: API key for the review provider. **Prefer setting `UMACTUALLY_API_KEY` as a secret pipeline variable.** If you must paste it here, mark this input as a secret in the YAML (`secureEnv: UMACTUALLY_API_KEY`). Never hard-code in a committed pipeline definition.

inputs.name: model
inputs.label: Model
inputs.helpMarkDown: Provider model ID. `auto` (default) resolves per-provider + per-URL — see [provider protocol reference](https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/umactually/blob/main/docs/providers.md#model-auto-resolution-on-dual-protocol-gateways). Use a pinned synthetic name only when a maintainer asks for it.

inputs.name: provider
inputs.label: Provider family
inputs.helpMarkDown: **openai-compatible** (default) — any OpenAI-protocol gateway. **anthropic** — uses the native Anthropic Messages API. **copilot** — uses GitHub Copilot via the GitHub API base. On dual-protocol gateways, `--provider` is advisory: the dispatcher transparently falls back to the OTHER protocol at the same URL when the named protocol returns a routing-level rejection (404). See [docs/providers.md#cross-protocol-auto-discovery-the-dispatcher](https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/umactually/blob/main/docs/providers.md).

inputs.name: githubApiBase
inputs.label: GitHub API base (Copilot only)
inputs.helpMarkDown: GitHub API base URL for Copilot token exchange. Defaults to `https://api.github.com`. Set to `https://<tenant>.ghe.com` for GitHub Enterprise Server.

inputs.name: effort
inputs.label: Reasoning effort
inputs.helpMarkDown: Reasoning effort hint forwarded to the provider as `reasoning.effort` (when supported). High catches more nuanced issues but takes longer.

inputs.name: minimumSeverity
inputs.label: Minimum severity
inputs.helpMarkDown: Findings below this tier are suppressed. **`security` and `leak` findings ALWAYS survive any threshold** — see the [security model](https://github.com/JosiahSiegel/umactually/blob/main/docs/security.md#minimum-severity-cannot-hide-leaks-or-security-findings). Default `medium` matches `action.yml`.

inputs.name: maxComments
inputs.label: Max inline comments
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cap on inline comments posted per run. Default 50 matches the post-side cap. Set to `0` for unlimited (not recommended — large PRs produce noisy threads).

inputs.name: reviewFileLimit
inputs.label: Max changed files
inputs.helpMarkDown: Cap on the number of changed files the live review will process. PRs that exceed this get a 'diff too large' parent card with zero findings — the per-chunk LLM reviews of huge initial-import diffs produce hallucinated findings. Set to `0` to disable.

inputs.name: includeSonarqube
inputs.label: Include SonarQube context
inputs.helpMarkDown: If true, fetches prior findings from SonarQube and injects them into the review prompt so the model doesn't re-report what's already known. Requires the `sonarHostUrl`, `sonarToken`, and `sonarProjectKey` inputs.

inputs.name: sonarHostUrl
inputs.label: SonarQube host URL
inputs.helpMarkDown: Base URL of your SonarQube server (e.g. `https://sonarcloud.io` or `https://sonar.example.com`).

inputs.name: sonarToken
inputs.label: SonarQube token
inputs.helpMarkDown: SonarQube auth token. **Prefer a secret pipeline variable `UMACTUALLY_SONAR_TOKEN`.** If pasted here, mark as secret.

inputs.name: sonarProjectKey
inputs.label: SonarQube project key
inputs.helpMarkDown: SonarQube project key (often the repo name, e.g. `myorg_myrepo`).

inputs.name: noDryRun
inputs.label: Post review (live mode)
inputs.helpMarkDown: **Checked (default)** — the task posts inline review threads to the PR. **Unchecked** — the task generates the review payload but only logs it to the build output; no threads are posted. Use dry-run for first-time setup to verify the task works without polluting the PR.

inputs.name: detectLeaks
inputs.label: Run secret-leak detection
inputs.helpMarkDown: The diff is ALWAYS redacted before provider submission. This flag controls the leak-DETECTOR (which tags findings as `severity=leak` for thread display) on top of the always-on redaction. Default ON. Uncheck to suppress leak-detector findings on this PR (the redaction is independent and still runs).

inputs.name: reviewTimeoutSeconds
inputs.label: Review timeout (seconds)
inputs.helpMarkDown: Maximum review wall-clock time. Default 300s (5 minutes). The task fails with `ReviewTimeout` if exceeded. Increase for very large PRs or slow providers.

inputs.name: outputArtifact
inputs.label: Output artifact path
inputs.helpMarkDown: Path (relative to the build agent working directory) where the raw provider response is written. The file is published as a `umactually-review` pipeline artifact by the next `PublishPipelineArtifact@1` step in your pipeline. Set to an empty string to skip the write.

outputVariables.name: UMACTUALLY_REVIEWED
outputVariables.description: Set to `true` if the review ran to completion (posted or dry-run-generated). Set to `false` on any failure.

outputVariables.name: UMACTUALLY_FINDING_COUNT
outputVariables.description: Number of inline comments posted (live mode) or generated (dry-run mode). Zero if the review was suppressed by minimum-severity or the diff was empty.

outputVariables.name: UMACTUALLY_SEVERITY_HIGH_COUNT
outputVariables.description: Count of high-severity findings in the review.

messages.ReviewStarting: Starting UmActually review (provider={0}, model={1}, effort={2}, dry-run={3}).
messages.ReviewSucceeded: UmActually review complete. Posted {0} inline comment(s) in live mode.
messages.DryRunSucceeded: UmActually review complete (dry-run). Generated {0} comment(s) — see the output artifact.
messages.ReviewTimeout: UmActually review exceeded the configured timeout of {0} seconds.
